principle: Use capabilities where they are strongest in the lifecycle; never load the whole methodology into every phase.

adapters.name: Superpowers SDLC Adapter
selection_rules: brainstorm before coding for PROGRAM work and material product decisions
use writing-plans only after the solution direction is approved
choose subagent-driven-development when tasks are sequential but benefit from fresh contexts
choose dispatching-parallel-agents only for independent tasks
use executing-plans when the user wants human checkpoints rather than subagent dispatch
keep Superpowers telemetry disabled when project policy requires no external telemetry

adapters.name: GitHub Spec Kit Adapter
selection_rules: prefer for PROGRAM work needing explicit specification and traceability
do not duplicate equivalent approved project artifacts
Escapement remains the runtime and evidence orchestrator

adapters.name: GSD Phase Execution Adapter
selection_rules: use when fresh-context phase isolation is preferred
do not activate alongside the complete Superpowers execution methodology
select one methodology owner for implementation

adapters.name: Agent Reach Research Adapter
selection_rules: prefer safe mode for installation
keep tools outside the project workspace
review cookie, login and credential handling before platform access
use as supporting evidence rather than authority

adapters.name: Last30Days Trends Adapter
adapters.license: verify current repository licence before install
selection_rules: use only when the last 30 days can materially change the decision
follow the installed skill contract rather than improvising
separate trend signal from authoritative requirement
cite the underlying sources

adapters.name: 500+ AI Agent Blueprint Adapter
adapters.license: MIT for catalogue repository; linked projects retain their own licences
selection_rules: treat catalogue entries as leads, not deployable components
inspect the exact linked repository
verify licence, tests, maintenance, dependencies, data and security
request approval before cloning, adapting or deploying

adapters.name: Agent Browser Verification Adapter
selection_rules: prefer project Playwright tests when already present
restrict domains and authenticated sessions
capture browser evidence

adapters.name: Karpathy + Ponytail Engineering Adapter
selection_rules: Karpathy guidance remains the baseline
Ponytail is an optional implementation intensifier, not a second baseline
use Ponytail ultra only when code bloat is the explicit defect
do not let minimalism remove required controls, tests, accessibility or observability

adapters.name: Design Intelligence Specialist Adapter
selection_rules: design-intelligence.md is supreme and always governs design work
choose one primary art director in BRAINSTORM
use UI/UX Pro Max as a research and recommendation engine
use Impeccable primarily for verification and polish
use Emil only when motion exists or is justified
Open Design is an optional workspace or asset/prototype ecosystem, not a default skill stack

adapters.name: Browser Verification Adapter
selection_rules: use the project's existing browser framework first
prefer CLI and tests for token-efficient deterministic verification
use MCP only for exploratory or persistent browser loops
do not select archived Puppeteer MCP for new projects
restrict domains, credentials and file access
